name: Daniel L. Reback
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Encino, California
about: A vehement advocate for his clients, Daniel L. Reback works relentlessly and pursues every viable legal avenue to get his clients respite and relief in their contentious legal matters. From the law office of Krane & Smith in Encino, California, he serves individuals and businesses throughout the surrounding region, as well as across the Los Angeles metropolitan area, in legal issues pertaining to business litigation, employment law, real property litigation, intellectual property law, and appeals, among many others.

Mr. Reback completed his undergraduate studies in 2002, graduating with his bachelor’s degree in history from the University of Michigan. He went on to attend Loyola Law School, Los Angeles, where he sharpened his shrewd legal acumen and talents that are still evident in the advocacy he provides his clients with today. After receiving his Juris Doctor in 2005, he became admitted to practice law across all California state courts the same year.

During his time in law school, Mr. Reback’s academic prowess was evident through the many awards and recognitions he has accumulated, including inclusion in the dean’s list and receiving the First Honor Awards in labor law and appellate advocacy. As soon as he entered the legal profession, he strived to uphold the standard of client care in accordance with the stringent standards he set for his practice, and he leverages his 18-plus years of experience to give his clients the peace of mind they deserve so they can move forward with their business endeavors without worry of legal troubles.
